review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Null tiṇai, poet and speaker metadata remain reviewed-empty; mechanical hundred-poem and printed decad organization remain navigation only.

poet.note: The canonical record has no printed poet attribution.
